description: Audit a CycloneDX or SPDX JSON software bill of materials. Components are mapped to tracked products and scored for EOL risk; unmatched components are listed honestly rather than guessed. Pass the SBOM as a JSON string or object. Versions resolve to their release family (python 3.12, php 7.4, ubuntu 20.04). Without a key up to 5 matched components are scored per call; Starter 25; Pro 50. Larger SBOMs return the scored subset plus a note of how many were not checked.

max_items.description: Optional: return at most this many scored components (the tier cap applies first).

sbom.description: The SBOM document (JSON string or object). CycloneDX (bomFormat/components) or SPDX (spdxVersion/packages).

name: check_sbom
title: Check an SBOM
